card.name: Linking words before enzyme or transporter names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, by, or, the) and the verb ending in 'metabolized' that come right before a drug-metabolism enzyme or transporter term such as CYP3A4, P-gp or BCRP. Also fires on the 'B' that begins BCRP.

modes.label: Metabolized by enzyme
modes.description: The word 'metabolized' (cut after 'metabol') just before 'by CYP3A4'.

modes.label: Linking word in enzyme lists
modes.description: A joining word like 'or' or the first letter of a transporter name inside lists of enzymes, transporters and substrates.
modes.example: consideration should be given to initiating a revised regimen that does not include a CYP3A<< or>> P-gp inhibitor.

modes.label: Small word before a noun phrase
modes.description: A short word such as 'a', 'by' or 'the' that sits just before a descriptive noun phrase in non-drug text.
modes.example: The risk of suicidal thoughts or behavior was generally consistent among drugs in<< the>> data analyzed.

card.plain: It fires on small joining words and word parts just before enzyme or transporter names in drug interaction text.
